basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer from Texas, just getting into the world of Reddit and online communities. I enjoy playing racing games like Project Cars 3 and exploring new hobbies like aquaponics. When I'm not gaming, I work as a junior mechanical engineer at a local firm. My schedule is pretty packed, but I usually find time to browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. I'm single and live with a couple of roommates who are also into gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, which gives me a decent understanding of systems and processes. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and watching online tutorials, although I'm still learning about the technical aspects of game performance issues.
